# Life effects

Healing and growth. Life mends allies, cleanses poisons and makes plants grow.

27 life effects you can craft or find in the usual way. Life also has runes of the world, fused runes and innate runes: see their own pages.

Read [Reading Life Magic](../../spellcraft/life-outcomes.md) for the illustrated journal of actual healing, repair, gardens and living ward responses.

### ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/runes/bramble.png) Bramble


*Tier I · Life · Helps you and your allies · 6 mana · needs any Cord*

Thorns for 10 seconds: the next 4 things that hurt you from within 4 blocks take 3 damage and are shoved away.

**How to get it:** Craft: a Blank Rune, Sweet Berries and Cactus. The recipe is shapeless: any layout, any crafting grid.

![Crafting Bramble: a Blank Rune and Sweet Berries and Cactus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/recipes/rune_bramble.png)

**Modifiers that work on it:** Amplify, Extend, Frugal, Overcharge, Execute, Trial Key, Kindled, Unstable, Kindred, Thirst, Belated, Steady, Magnetic, Sowing, Furrowing, Fertile, Torchset, Ore Sensing, Sunlit, Fleecing

### ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/runes/root_carry.png) Root Carry


*Tier II · Life · Works on the world · 8 mana · needs a Copper Cord or better*

Two separate casts select and move one unchanged young Cinder Fern onto nearby visible soil. Selection lasts fifteen seconds; successful relocation starts a twenty-second rest. Refuses grown, changed, hidden, protected or unloaded roots.

**How to get it:** Craft: a Blank Rune, Rooted Dirt, Bone Meal and String, plus 2 Lapis Lazuli and a Gold Ingot. The recipe is shapeless: any layout, any crafting grid. Also found: Living Greenhouse; Rootbound Maze.

### ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/runes/venom.png) Venom


*Tier II · Life · Harms enemies · 8 mana · needs a Copper Cord or better*

2 damage now and 0.75 a second for 4 seconds, with Poison I: it can kill and works on undead and spiders. The poisoned pass it on, once, to up to 3 enemies within 2.5 blocks.

**How to get it:** Craft: a Blank Rune, Poisonous Potato, plus 2 Lapis Lazuli and a Gold Ingot. The recipe is shapeless: any layout, any crafting grid. Also found: Shipwrecks; Buried treasure; Trial vaults; Living Greenhouse; Rootbound Maze.

### ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/runes/drowse.png) Drowse


*Tier III · Life · Harms enemies · 14 mana · needs an Amethyst Cord or better*

Sleepy pollen lulls each target to sleep for 6 seconds (2 on players): it can't move or fight back, but any damage wakes it, and the blow that does deals 75% more. Bosses only grow drowsy.

**How to get it:** Craft: a Blank Rune, Spore Blossom and Honey Bottle, plus a Mana Crystal and a Diamond. The recipe is shapeless: any layout, any crafting grid. Also found: Ancient cities; Living Greenhouse; Rootbound Maze.

![Crafting Drowse: a Blank Rune and Spore Blossom and Honey Bottle, plus a Mana Crystal and a Diamond](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/recipes/rune_drowse.png)

### ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/defnotean/wildercord/main/wiki/assets/runes/reversal.png) Reversal


*Tier IV · Life · Helps you and your allies · 28 mana · needs an Echo Cord*

For 30 seconds, one killing blow is reversed: back to half health instead of dying. Once death has been cheated, nothing turns it back again for a minute.

**How to get it:** Never crafted. Where it comes from: Ominous vaults; Archive vaults; the Archivist.

**Modifiers that work on it:** Extend, Frugal, Steady, Magnetic, Sowing, Furrowing, Fertile, Torchset, Ore Sensing, Sunlit, Fleecing
